key_points: Most coverage is recycled commentary: an 'up 0.5% since earnings' recap and two valuation pieces citing an 18% five-year slide are not new information.
Euro-denominated bond pricing is routine REIT refinancing and largely neutral absent disclosed terms or size.
A proposed cash settlement of a long-running dispute (India/Vodafone-Idea-type overhang) is a mild positive if it clears a litigation/collection risk, but details are thin.
Uniti's unrelated 9.6% move carries no read-through to AMT fundamentals.
No change to earnings, guidance, or capital allocation thesis; keep estimates and positioning unchanged.
